description: Fabric mod: shows your current music (Spotify, browser, anything) as an in-game overlay with album art, a live progress bar and synced lyrics. Works on 26.1.2 and 26.2.

mods.name: Music Overlay
mods.description: Shows whatever you're playing (Spotify, YouTube, anything with media keys) as a clean in-game overlay, with album art, a live progress bar and time-synced lyrics. Fully themeable and repositionable.
